title: The Talk Show With John Gruber

description: The director’s commentary track for Daring Fireball. Long digressions on Apple, technology, design, movies, and more.

extraits.texte: John Gruber shows nice attention to detail and tries to always be right. He has integrity and insight. His guests are good. I find listening to his shows interesting and relaxing.

Puisque John Gruber incite ses auditeurs à donner 1 étoile aux applis qui incitent leurs utilisateurs a les noter, ça me semble justifié qu'il "subisse" ce qu'il veut faire subir aux autres. Autrement, bonne émission.
I think 1 star reviews make more for it than 5 stars'. This podcast is just like some french movies, the more it's hated, the better. John, tu es le bienvenu en France !
